subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving channel-selective replies to a separate delivery-policy/API design?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but allowing prompts or rules to choose delivery channels would change channel/message delivery policy and could affect plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track prompt-driven channel-selective replies separately before changing deterministic reply delivery behavior.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Document that reply routing remains host-controlled after the command metadata gap is fixed.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest history on /context and shared command prompt bundle behavior and already posted the most specific issue scope guidance.
